IT GRANTS THE CAPABILITY TO EXACTLY ONE FILE AND THE SUITE SAYS WHICH: `src/sweeps/ledger.ts`, on the ONE-DOOR pattern ADR-165 set for `@merit/db` at `src/db.ts`. `src/sweeps/ports.ts` still imports nothing, so `ExpiryTx` keeps three members and `EXPIRY_TABLES` still excludes both ledger keys (ADR-315).
//dependencies.@merit/queue: ADDED BY ADR-327, AND IT IS THE LINE THIS DEPLOYABLE'S BARREL HAS ASKED FOR SINCE SESSION 147. ADR-326 REFUSED IT FOR A MEASURED REASON AND `0082_pgboss_app_grants.sql` REMOVED THAT REASON: `0026`'s grants are all scoped `IN SCHEMA public`, so `merit_app` held neither `USAGE` nor `CREATE` on `pgboss` and every one of `JobQueue`'s five methods threw `permission denied for schema pgboss`; a manifest line whose one call throws buys a resolvable import and no job. `0082` grants `USAGE` plus the fifteen table privileges pg-boss was MEASURED to need, and deliberately NOT `CREATE`. IT GRANTS THE CAPABILITY TO NO FILE YET, WHICH IS THE ONE HALF ADR-327 COULD NOT LAND: `@merit/ledger` above names `src/sweeps/ledger.ts` and `@merit/db` names `src/db.ts`, on the ONE-DOOR pattern ADR-165 set, and the row that writes this deployable's queue door is the one that will name it here. `test/schedule.test.ts` case 5.1 asserts the line and the absent importer TOGETHER, so neither half can drift alone.
